description: Read one Hebrew rights guide by its id, for example "tax/income-tax-exemption". Long guides return an overview and a list of sections; the optional "section" parameter returns one section. Each guide lists eligibility, amounts with dates, the claim process, forms and official sources.

section.description: Optional section heading (or part of it) to read, for example "תהליך הגשה".

name: get_rights_guide
title: קריאת מדריך זכויות
